title: Facile synthesis of C–TiO2–MoS2 nanocomposite based on commercial TiO2 nanopowder for photodegradation of methylene blue
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25548-25559
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03330F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thi Huyen Nguyen, Tien Dung Cao, Thi Phuong Mai, Van Hau Tran, Van Trinh Pham, Van Chuc Nguyen, Van Nhat Pham, Viet Tiep Phung, Ngoc Minh Phan, Van Tan Tran, Van Hao Nguyen, Huy Tiep Nguyen, Van Tu Nguyen
The C–TiO2–MoS2 nanocomposite was prepared via a facile mixing and annealing process, achieving 99.6% degradation under UV light and 99.4% under visible light for MB (10−4 M) within 45 min due to enhanced charge separation and light absorption.
